in_fence.definition: Hard-coded presentational string with zero binding to DB/RPC/derived values; fixing a typo or misspelling only.
allowed_loci: Static JSX/TSX string literals in labels, headings, empty-state prose, button captions that do not gate actions
STATUS_HELP / instructional help text objects when values are prose only (not status keys)
Bricely customer-safe intro / hint copy under src/bricely/config.ts (look only)
examples_safe: Typo in LoadBoardKanban Create Load modal helper: 'New loads are placed in "Unsold" status…'
Misspelling in SellerPortal guide step detail string

in_fence.definition: title=, aria-label, Info/help prose that explains UI without changing visibility or data.
allowed_loci: aria-label on Close / Sign out / icon-only controls
title= truncations that only add hover text already shown elsewhere as the same static string
examples_safe: Clarify STATUS_HELP.process wording without renaming status key 'process'

in_fence.definition: PURELY aesthetic CSS only: color, font-family, font-size, font-weight, and spacing/margin/padding that does NOT reflow or move controls. Zero impact on what the user can see or reach.
allowed_loci: color / background-color / text color tokens already in palette
font-family, font-size, font-weight on static (non-control) text
margin/padding ONLY when it does not reflow, reposition, or move interactive controls or data cells
examples_safe: Change heading text color token on a static title
Increase font-weight on a static section label without shifting buttons
explicitly_forbidden_even_under_css: position / absolute / fixed / sticky that moves controls
hide / reveal (display:none, visibility, opacity-0 on controls, hidden, sr-only used to remove affordances)
resize / width/height changes that reflow or cover controls
pointer-events / cursor changes that alter clickability
gap/padding/margin that reflows or moves controls or data cells
any class that changes which data or controls the user can see or reach

in_fence.definition: Comments / JSDoc / internal markdown under wmg-canonical that operators never see as product behavior.
allowed_loci: docs/uat notes that do not change shipped UI
examples_safe: Clarify comment above STATUS_CONFIG without touching keys

explicitly_excluded.why: STATUS_CONFIG keys (process/unconfirmed/uncovered/covered/…) drive board column membership and DnD targets — changing label+key coupling changes what SHOWS where.
examples: Renaming status key 'uncovered' or remapping loads between columns
Changing option value= in board filters that filter by status key

explicitly_excluded.why: Looks like 'label' but renders DB/RPC fields — changing format or which field is shown changes what is SHOWN.
examples: fmt(balanceDue) / commission / invoice amounts
(lbs/2000).toFixed — tonnage display
release_number, memo_number, pickup_window cells
PAYMENT_STATUS_LABEL[paymentEvent.status] mapping
Welcome firstName from buyer.contact / seller.contact / auth full_name

explicitly_excluded.why: Nav labels are paired with view ids gated by canAccessView / featurePermissions — changing id or gating changes DO.
examples: allNavItems id: 'load-board' / 'accounting'
Portal NAV screen ids home|statements|invoices

explicitly_excluded.why: hidden/opacity-0/display:none/conditional render changes what controls or data appear.
examples: Hiding Allocate / Send memo buttons via CSS
canViewAccounting && … branches
filter pills that remove cards from the board
Any SalesMemos / AR / statement / aging / pricing string that formats money
allocate / deallocate / reassign / set-load-memo-rate / split-load UI copy that describes irreversible actions if it changes CTA meaning
LoginPage copy that changes auth flow
PortalAccessAdmin invite strings tied to grant actions

explicitly_excluded.why: Changing diagnostic logic, escalation rules, or liveFix kinds is behavior — not Lane 1.
examples: diagnostic.ts terminal routing
intake payload shape
turn caps

explicitly_excluded.why: Unsure in WMG OS = escalate always. Mixed cosmetic+logic PR = escalate.
